title: Each install's deploy source is its own clone, never a worktree of another checkout
description: On temporary repositories: an install's deploy source that is a linked worktree of another checkout is replaced by a standalone clone at the same commit on the next upgrade --watch start, keeping its origin and release pointer, and still resolves its commit after the other checkout is deleted; a fresh setup creates a standalone clone and adds no worktree to the source; doctor's deploy-source line fails naming a worktree deploy source and passes for a clone.

steps.name: Replace a worktree deploy source with a clone, delete the other checkout, and read doctor's line
